description: A small black USB hub sits on the bed in front of a pillow, with a loose cable and USB plug lying across the fabric. The left hand slides in from the left to steady the hub as a left-hand object, while the right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the USB plug as a right-hand object, guides it downward into a port on the top of the hub, presses to seat it, and then releases as both hands pull back.
